{
  "scholarshipName": "University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship",
  "scholarshipAmount": "34468",
  "scholarshipType": "Amount",
  "scholarshipMetaData": [
    "Supports excellent domestic and international doctoral candidates whose research aligns with the strategic objectives of the University of Auckland.",
    "Applicable programmes: PhD, DMedSc, DClinPsy, DocFA, EdD and DHSc.",
    "Term: up to 42 months of full-time equivalent enrolment.",
    "Application: no separate application is required. Applicants indicate in their doctoral application that they wish to be considered.",
    "Selection: based on alignment with the strategic objectives of the University and the relevant faculty or research institute.",
    "Eligibility: applicant must be a domestic student, or an international student who is eligible to pay domestic fees for the doctoral programme.",
    "Eligibility: applicant must not already hold a doctorate or have previously received payment for a University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship.",
    "Eligibility: applicant must not be enrolled in a doctoral programme, except for approved transfers.",
    "More information: https://www.auckland.ac.nz/assets/study/scholarships-and-funding/find-a-scholarship-or-award/regulations/university-of-auckland-doctoral-scholarship.pdf"
  ]
}
